name: representative-pilot
selection_rule: Stratify existing 802 documents by site, document/sign-count band and source-defined word availability; preserve document clustering.
scientific_boundary: Pilot supports robustness and representation tests, not linguistic identification.
freeze_policy: Membership and selection rules freeze before target-result inspection.
cross_corpus_rule: Pilot strata remain native; cross-script identity is never inferred by inclusion.
